texto: The thematic vocal of each conjugation is preserved: **-are** da **-avo, -avi, -ava, -avamo, -avate, -avano** (* giocare → giocavo *); **-ere** da **-evo, -evi, -eva, -evamo, -evate, -evano** (* kirvere → scrivevo *); **-ire** da **-ivo, -ivi, -iva, -ivamo, -ivate, -ivano** (* partire → partivo *).

To know these terminations allows you to describe any past routine: * Da piccoli giocavamo spesso insieme * (from little ones we played often together); * Mentre studiavamo, pioveva * (as we studied, rain).

bloques.titulo: Table of deinences of the imperfect

frases.it: Da piccolo giocavi spesso a calcio, Marco?
frases.es: De pequeño, ¿jugabas a menudo al fútbol, Marco?
frases.en: When you were a kid, did you often play football, Marco?

frases.it: Sì! Mentre i miei amici studiavano, io giocavo sempre in cortile.
frases.es: ¡Sí! Mientras mis amigos estudiaban, yo jugaba siempre en el patio.
frases.en: Yes! While my friends were studying, I was always playing in the yard.

frases.it: E che cosa facevi la sera a casa?
frases.es: ¿Y qué hacías por la tarde-noche en casa?
frases.en: And what were you doing late night at home?

frases.it: Scrivevo i compiti e leggevo un libro a letto.
frases.es: Escribía los deberes y leía un libro en la cama.
frases.en: He wrote his homework and read a book in bed.

frases.it: Anche noi leggevamo molto quando eravamo piccoli!
frases.es: ¡También nosotros leíamos mucho cuando éramos pequeños!
frases.en: We used to read a lot when we were little!

frases.it: Eravamo sempre contenti e avevamo molti amici.
frases.es: Estábamos siempre contentos y teníamos muchos amigos.
frases.en: We were always happy and we had a lot of friends.
analisis: We had a lot of friends

bloques.pregunta: What is the form of «noi» imperfect for the «studiare» verb?

opciones.explicacion: Word in -are: the first person of the plural adopts the desinence -avamo.
This is the form of an indicative present.
It's the form of prossimo passage.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «They were leaving early every morning.»?

opciones.explicacion: «Partire» forms the third plural person of imperfect in -ivano.
It would indicate a single finished output in prossimo passage.

bloques.frase: Da bambini noi ___ spesso in cortile dopo la scuola.

opciones.explicacion: «noi» subject with verb in -are: regular deinence -avamo.

bloques.frase: Mentre studiavamo a casa, pioveva molto.

opciones.texto: Two simultaneous actions under way in the past.
opciones.explicacion: Both verbs in imperfect express parallel processes.

opciones.texto: An action that ended before it started to rain.
That we studied just for a minute because it didn't rain.
opciones.explicacion: It is contrary to the affirmative meaning of the text.

bloques.pregunta: What grammatical value do verbs have?
bloques.frase: Io scrivevo una lettera e mio fratello ascoltava la musica.

opciones.texto: A time-by-time action that interrupted the other.
opciones.explicacion: Neither one of them is interrupted; both are in imperfect.

opciones.texto: Dos acciones futuras acordadas de antemano.
opciones.explicacion: Both verbs are in past time.

bloques.frase: Da piccolo giocavo spesso con gli amici
bloques.traduccion: When I was a kid I often played with friends
bloques.explicacion: Expression of children's habit with regular imperfect at -avo.

bloques.pregunta: What endpoint of imperfect corresponds to «voi» in the verbs in -ere?

opciones.explicacion: The second person in the plural of the second conjugation adopts -evate (leggevate, scrivevate).
This termination corresponds to the verbs in -are (parlavate).
This termination corresponds to the verbs in -ire (sentivate).

intro: It consolves the disinences of the imperfect in the three conjugations and learns to combine them with a loose.
